description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +30% (8s)] to party, grants [Attach Fire with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Dual Awoken Samurai Mode I (Cor)] to the user, grants [XV Resonance +3% Boost] to all XV allies

description.name: Dual Awoken Samurai Mode I (Cor)
description.text: Samurai abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Samurai abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00 for equipped Samurai abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Samurai Mode II (Cor)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Samurai Mode II (Cor)
description.text: Samurai abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, instant cast speed for Samurai abilities, casts Dual Lion Flash after using Samurai abilities

description.name: Dual Lion Flash
description.text: One single attack (2.64) capped at 99999, causes [Imperil Prismatic 10% (15s)]/[Imperil Prismatic 30% (15s)] if 0-3/4+ XV allies are alive

description.name: Imperil Prismatic 10% (15s)
description.text: Causes [Imperil Fire 10% (15s)], [Imperil Ice 10% (15s)], [Imperil Lightning 10% (15s)], [Imperil Earth 10% (15s)], [Imperil Wind 10% (15s)], [Imperil Water 10% (15s)], [Imperil Holy 10% (15s)], [Imperil Dark 10% (15s)] and [Imperil Poison 10% (15s)]

description.name: Imperil Prismatic 30% (15s)
description.text: Causes [Imperil Fire 30% (15s)], [Imperil Ice 30% (15s)], [Imperil Lightning 30% (15s)], [Imperil Earth 30% (15s)], [Imperil Wind 30% (15s)], [Imperil Water 30% (15s)], [Imperil Holy 30% (15s)], [Imperil Dark 30% (15s)] and [Imperil Poison 30% (15s)]

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: XV Resonance +3% Boost
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 3% if the character's Realm is XV
